listing.name: Dune II (Dune Dynasty)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Enhanced OpenDUNE-derived native engine with current Win/Linux/macOS releases. Limits: Enhanced OpenDUNE-derived engine with current desktop releases; EUv1.07 game data required. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux/macOS release packages. README build jobs distinguish Windows x86/x86-64/ARM64 and macOS x86-64/ARM64; artifact CPU must follow selected release rather than CI badges. Original data: Requires EU v1.07 Dune II PAK files; separate project identity from OpenDUNE. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.

steps.title: Finish Dune Dynasty setup before attaching it
steps.instruction: Use a permitted complete Windows Dune Dynasty copy with your own European Dune II 1.07 PAK files, following upstream’s FILELIST.TXT. Keep those data files in the prepared data directory or the actual personal Dune Dynasty/data directory used by the copy. Missing original data makes normal startup fail; attaching the engine alone does not prepare it. Optional music, soundfonts and enhancements have separate requirements and rights.

steps.title: Keep the existing portable or personal profile choice
steps.instruction: Select native dunedynasty.exe and its actual prepared working directory. Keep dunedynasty.cfg: an existing executable-side config selects portable state; otherwise Windows normally uses the current account’s roaming AppData/Dune Dynasty profile. Do not create an executable-side config merely to register the game. Preserve that whole actual profile, its save directory, configuration, original data, custom campaigns/music and the old creating runtime before replacement. Original-format save reading is not a promise that every newer save works in an older engine.

steps.title: Check the working copy before registration
steps.instruction: Finish upstream setup and a normal start/quit using the intended copy before attaching it. Retain its exact native executable, working directory and established supported literal arguments. Review the selected intent and consent, then choose Play separately. Attaching a copy does not certify the game, its original assets or its save compatibility.

steps.title: Keep updates and removal under the existing owner
steps.instruction: Close all actual game instances before changing files. Keep the old creating runtime and every actual data/profile root recoverable, make deliberate compatible updates upstream, then review/relink a changed executable before the next Play. Upstream/player owns preparation, updates, writes, migration and recovery. Portcove supervises its selected process; this is not an exclusive instance lock or a sandbox. Removing this registration preserves external files. This route does not offer Portcove-managed downloads, setup, updates, backup, rollback, migration or external-file deletion.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. Engine licensing does not grant rights to original game assets, music, mods or bundled components.
Preserve every actual external runtime and player-data location before upstream changes. Shared profiles are not isolated by choosing a different executable.
